deliverables.description: Automated ADR authoring pipeline: best-practice-research -> planning-and-task-breakdown/ralplan/plan -> consensus -> ADR (generative template), wired as a governed workflow.
deliverables.exit_criteria: an ADR can be produced end-to-end by the pipeline; the ADR carries an evidence[] block citing research + a consensus record.

deliverables.description: Propagation engine: an accepted ADR regenerates the masterplan + every artifact named in its affected_surfaces (trickle-down).
deliverables.exit_criteria: `oya gen propagate <ADR>` regenerates masterplan + affected_surfaces; idempotent.

deliverables.description: Propagation drift gate: every affected_surfaces artifact is consistent with the ADRs that drive it (committed == regenerated).
deliverables.exit_criteria: gate fails when an affected doc is hand-edited out of sync with its ADR.

deliverables.description: ADR-provenance gate: a planning_impact ADR must cite best-practice-research evidence + a consensus record; no ADR bypasses the pipeline.
deliverables.exit_criteria: gate fails an ADR missing evidence[]/consensus provenance.

deliverables.description: Door-classification autonomy gate: `door: two-way` ADRs auto-merge on green; `door: one-way` require founder sign-off (the agent autonomy boundary).
deliverables.exit_criteria: merge automation honors door; one-way ADR cannot auto-merge.

deliverables.description: COE->gate flywheel: every incident/agent-failure Correction-of-Error must terminate at a missing gate/spec/automation and emit a new gate (never 'human/agent error').
deliverables.exit_criteria: COE template + gate rejecting a human-error root cause; each COE links a new/updated gate.

deliverables.description: Ownership-sharding: a single-threaded owner-agent per service/lane owning disjoint paths; concurrent-safe-paths admission prevents two lanes editing the same path.
deliverables.exit_criteria: owner declared per service in catalog; admission gate rejects overlapping concurrent claims.

deliverables.description: High-throughput merge path: merge-queue speculative rebase (ADR-0111) + affected-targets + two-tier presubmit(fast/affected/blocking) vs postsubmit(full + regression attribution).
deliverables.exit_criteria: concurrent green PRs serialize through the queue without manual rebase; postsubmit bisects the culprit on a break.

deliverables.description: Self-repair loop: deterministic auto-fix (fmt, rebase, regenerate drifted docs via ADR-0365 propagation, quarantine flaky tests, draft COE->gate); escalate to human ONLY for one-way-door / non-deterministic / unrepairable.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a protocol violation is auto-detected and auto-repaired end-to-end with no human step in the deterministic cases; escalation only otherwise.

deliverables.description: Anti-waste / anti-thin-scaffold gates: PR-FAQ before a new service exists; Definition-of-Done completion gate (tests+docs+ADR+SLO+evidence) so 'green' means substance, not scaffold.
deliverables.exit_criteria: a new service without a PR-FAQ is blocked; a half-done change fails DoD.

deliverables.description: Quality/resilience gates: automated canary analysis (Kayenta-style statistical judge on Argo Rollouts), chaos GameDay (SLO-gated), error-budget policy + promotion freeze.
deliverables.exit_criteria: promotion is statistically gated; over-budget freezes non-critical promotion; a chaos experiment runs SLO-gated.
